notes.title: Demo V1.1 Patch now available!
notes.content:
[b]Demo v1.1 Patch Now Available![/b]

Thanks to everyone who has tried UNDETECTED and sent feedback! We are working on making it the best it can be!

[b]New features for the demo:[/b]

[list]
[*] New visibility indicator - Kaan's tattoos glow when he is invisible
[*] New difficulty mode "Classic" - for people who want the classic stealth action experience
[*] Fixed issues with long grass and lights
[/list]
